title: SHIFT-QC software and public-safe reproducibility materials

creators.name: Eraslan, Feti Çağrı
creators.affiliation: Istanbul University, Faculty of Computer and Information Technologies

description: Original SHIFT-QC software and public-safe reproducibility materials accompanying the SHIFT-QC manuscript. This is a software archive, not a source medical dataset or patient-derived dataset deposit. Source images, masks, patient-level/source-derived artefacts, unresolved aggregate ledgers, and trained weights are excluded. Full source-data-dependent reproduction requires independently obtaining source datasets from their official custodians. MIT covers original SHIFT-QC software only; documentation, citation metadata, manifests and conceptual figures retain separate rights as described in DATA_AND_ARTIFACT_RIGHTS.md. Version 1.1.0 adds the synthetic finite-sample study of the R5/R8 estimators (protocol, code, tests and its four result files), which uses simulated data only.
